set.body:
Source: review finding in modules/managed/.../FileJournalControlStore.scala:54-68.

Problem:
transact can be canceled after a journal record is appended and fsynced but before the in-memory state is advanced. A later transaction can append the same revision, making restart replay permanently fail as JournalCorrupt.

Acceptance:
- Treat append, force, and state publication as one uncancelable commit region, while retaining cancellation at safe boundaries.
- Define the outcome of cancellation before append and after commit without weakening durability.
- Add deterministic cancellation-injection tests at each commit boundary.
- Prove restart replay remains openable, revisions stay unique, and a committed transition is never lost from memory.
set.title: P6f.1: Make journal commits cancellation-atomic
